# Seekers Guild

> A decentralized, student-led community in the Philippines, founded in April 2025. It empowers curious and driven minds, especially from the provinces and underserved sectors, through collaboration, real-world experiences and opportunities beyond the classroom. Motto: "We seek those who seek."

Seekers Guild is an AI student builder community: developers, designers, marketers and young founders from colleges and senior high schools. Membership is free and open; new members join on the endorsement of two existing members.

## Programmes

- Open Table: monthly gathering at a café on the last Sunday of every month, usually from 2:00 PM. Open to the public.
- LockIn Villa × Founders Live Manila: three-day, two-night builder retreat; builders present what they shipped on Day 3.
- Outreach Program: twice a year, workshops in a barangay or municipality outside Manila.
- Awards & Recognition: yearly evening recognising top contributors, followed by investor networking.

## Values

- Vision: to awaken a generation of inspired trailblazers, students transformed not by what school alone can offer, but by the exposure, experience and empowerment they find beyond it.
- Five pillars: purpose-driven collaboration; inclusive community culture; decentralized empowerment; open knowledge exchange; continuous learning and development.
